metadata.description: Workspace mods (function-hook plugins) for deb-antigravity-claude-workspace; loaded in every session via .claude/settings.json

plugins.name: jev-router-mod
plugins.description: Runs the Jev prompt router (execution/infrastructure/jev_router.py hook) on each typed prompt, attaches its routing line as model context, and shows the route in a one-line band.

plugins.name: safety-guard-mod
plugins.description: Guards Bash calls: rewrites destructive commands to safe forms, blocks hard-dangerous ones, asks via a band for the rest.

plugins.name: done-notify-mod
plugins.description: Toasts elapsed time and token usage when a turn ends, a notification is raised, or a question waits; also sends a native notification.

plugins.name: session-ledger-mod
plugins.description: Pane ledger of files edited, tool outcomes, safety-guard rewrites and directives touched; writes a handoff file.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: See the current context window fill and remaining tokens.

plugins.name: quota-watch
plugins.description: Inspect reported plan windows and their reset times.

plugins.name: tool-timing
plugins.description: Measure observed tool latency, call counts, and failures.

plugins.name: linkedin-connect
plugins.description: Daily LinkedIn connection-request routine, self-contained skill for Cowork scheduled runs
